description: Realistic gaps between two good methods (research digest section 2: about 0-10 points), on the round-2 learner with mild everyday noise: 10% missed days and a little skipping when a fail is expected. The method effect is in logits; the realised percentage-point gaps are reported per row (about 0, 3, 5, 8 and 10 points; minus rows are calibrated to -5 and -9.5 points, because the same logit shift moves recall more downward near the ceiling). These rows measure how often a design gives a usable, correct answer.
